title: Shield Breaker
tagline: Bounce a shot off your ship to break a capital ship's shield panels, then its hull plates.
description: Each level is a capital ship laid out in plates: a Farragut Battle Cruiser, a Majestic Interdictor, a Thargoid Titan, then round again, faster. Its outline is shield panels that take two hits; inside is the hull, with armour that takes three and a core worth the most. Broken plates drop power-ups: multiball, a wider ship, a slower shot, and now and then a rebuy.
